camel_example: aliyun dts ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --NextToken 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec20000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the tags bound to data migration, data synchronization, and change tracking instances. You can also query the instances bound to specific tags
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询迁移、同步和订阅实例绑定的标签，也可以查询标签所绑定的实例
kebab_example: aliyun dts list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec20000 --resource-id dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，取值固定为：ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The query token.
If a single request does not return all results, you can pass the NextToken value returned from the previous request in the subsequent request to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
查询凭证。
如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入上一次查询返回的NextToken参数继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query instance IDs.
N specifies the sequence number of the instance ID. For example, ResourceId.0 specifies the first instance ID, and ResourceId.1 specifies the second instance ID. You can query 1 to 50 instance IDs at a time.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and Tag.N.Key
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移、同步和订阅的实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html。
N表示传入第几个实例ID。例如：ResourceId.0表示传入第一个实例ID；ResourceId.1表示传入第二个实例ID。可以同时查询1~50个实例ID。
该参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个
parameters.name: resource_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.0.Key specifies the first tag key, and Tag.1.Key specifies the second tag key. You can query 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
You must specify at least one of this parameter and ResourceId.N. An empty string is not allowed
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。
N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如：Tag.0.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.1.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。可以同时查询1~20个标签键。
该参数和ResourceId.N参数至少传入一个，且传入时不允许传入空字符串
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.0.Value specifies the first tag value, and Tag.1.Value specifies the second tag value. You can query 1 to 20 tag values at a time.
An empty string is allowed
element_fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如：Tag.0.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.1.Value表示传入第二个标签的值。可以同时查询1~20个标签值。
允许传入空字符串
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key
parameters.name: tag
